facts.value: As part of your study program in another department, you can complete certain modules in our Department of Business Administration, known as export modules from the Department of Business Administration - including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.

For study programs in other departments, a summary is provided of which export modules you can register for in the Department of Business Administration and how you can incorporate these export modules into your study program in your department. Furthermore, you may not bring in any other modules from the Department of Business Administration into your study program in another department and may not earn differing credit points (CP) from the Department of Business Administration.
